title: Enabling cacheComponents breaks the build on export const dynamic, revalidate, fetchCache or dynamicParams
symptoms: Route segment config "dynamicParams" is not compatible with `nextConfig.cacheComponents`.
A similar build error for dynamic = 'force-dynamic', revalidate = 60 or fetchCache
A third-party template that exports these configs stops building after the flag is turned on
cause: cacheComponents replaces the per-segment caching switches with use cache, cacheLife and Suspense, so the old exports are rejected rather than ignored.
fix: Delete each export and use the replacement: remove force-dynamic and let Suspense handle it, map revalidate to cacheLife inside use cache, and replace dynamicParams = false with notFound() for unknown params.
